events.label: Intermittent monitor alarm
events.summary: An intermittent alarm starts a clinical question. It does not authorise a shock or airway replacement by itself.

events.label: Resource allocation pressure
events.summary: Suction battery has arrived; transport remains held. Planning window for G1 bundles before further instability.

events.label: Further alarm escalation
events.summary: Alarm pattern worsens. Non-urgent planning must yield if emergency override engages.

events.label: H5 emergency override
events.summary: Pulseless VT pathway. No clinical questions during rescue. AAC protected in place. No airway replacement. Proceed toward provisional ROSC.

events.label: Provisional ROSC signal
events.summary: Circulation appears restored but remains provisional until independent confirmation and post-event reassessment.

events.label: Post-event reassessment window
events.summary: After provisional ROSC, reassessment and AAC restore are required before debrief.
